content.text:
VERDICT: LGTM

The membership number is derived entirely from two fields that already live on `Owner` (`customerCode` and `registrationDate`), so a read-only derived getter on the entity is the natural home — it sits directly after the `customerCode` accessors, mirroring the existing accessor layout. The null-guard matches the "null when either is absent" contract stated in the Javadoc, nothing is duplicated, and no class/method is turning into a catch-all. The `openapi.yml` entry is additive and consistent with the adjacent `customerCode`/`householdId` property definitions (title/description/example/`readOnly: true`). A maintainer of this codebase would find it natural.
